translations.А ведь им было велено лишь поклоняться А: But they were ordered only to worship Allah, serving Him sincerely, like the Hanifs, to perform prayer and pay zakat. This is the right faith
translations.А после этого — быть одним из тех, котор: And after this - to be one of those who believed and commanded one another patience and mercy
translations.А с чем в тот День сравниваются горы?: And what are the mountains compared to on that Day?
translations.А те, которые не уверовали в Наши знамен: And those who did not believe in Our signs are the people of the left side
translations.А тем, кто уверовал и творил добро, угот: And for those who believed and did good, there were prepared gardens where rivers flowed. This is great success
translations.А тех, кто отвернётся и не уверует: And those who turn away and do not believe
translations.А того, кто пришёл к тебе со рвением: And the one who came to you with zeal
translations.А тому, кто был скуп и полагал, что не н: And the one who was stingy and believed that he did not need Allah
translations.А тот, кому книга будет вручена из-за сп: And the one to whom the book will be handed from behind
translations.Абаса означает «Нахмурился». Сура ниспос: Abasa means "Frown." The surah was revealed about an incident when, during a conversation with the nobility of Mecca, a blind companion, Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum, approached the Prophet ﷺ, seeking knowledge, and was left without attention. Allah teaches: a sincere seeker of truth is more valuable than an indifferent rich man. Further, the sura reminds a person of what he was created from.
translations.Ад-Духа означает «Утро». Сура утешает Пр: Ad-Dukha means "Morning". The sura consoles the Prophet, peace be upon him: the Lord has not abandoned him, the future is better for him than the present, and in response to mercy he is commanded to be kind to the orphan and the one who asks.
translations.Адаб — это уважительное поведение. Перед: Adab is respectful behavior. Before reading the Quran, it is important to choose a quiet place, take your time, listen carefully and treat the text with respect.
translations.Адиты (народ Ирама), самудяне и Фараон: Adites (people of Iram), Thamudians and Pharaoh
translations.Аз-Зальзаля означает «Землетрясение». Су: Az-Zalzala means "Earthquake". The Sura describes the shaking of the earth on the Day of Judgment and the result: a person will see even good or evil the weight of a speck of dust.
translations.Азкар — это поминание Аллаха короткими с: Azkar is remembering Allah in short words. The most famous are: “SubkhanAllakh” (Glorified is Allah), “Alhamdulillah” (Praise be to Allah), “Allakhu Akbar” (Allah is Great) and “Lya ilyakha illya Llakh” (There is no god but Allah). They are easy to repeat throughout the day; This is a gentle and beloved practice by many.
Alif often conveys a long “a” sound.
translations.Алиф, Ба, Та: звук, форма и голос: Alif, Ba, Ta: sound, form and voice
translations.Алиф, Вав и Йа удлиняют звук: Alif, Vav and Ya lengthen the sound
translations.Аллах возвышает уверовавших и обладателе: Allah exalts those who believe and those who have knowledge
translations.Аллах же объемлет их со всех сторон: Allah embraces them on all sides
translations.Аллах подвергнет величайшим мучениям: Allah will subject you to the greatest torment
translations.Аллах услышал обращение женщины и её раз: Allah heard the woman's appeal and her conversation
translations.Аллязи халякаль-маута валь-хаята лияблюв: Allyazi khalyakal-mauta val-khayata liyablyuvakum ayyukum akhsanu amalya
Al-Adiyat means "Rushing" (horses). The sura swears by racing horses and reminds that man is ungrateful to his Lord, and on the Day of Judgment everything hidden will be revealed.
translations.Аль-Аля означает «Всевышний». Сура велит: Al-Alya means "The Most High". The Sura commands to glorify the name of the Lord, reminds of His creation and instruction, and teaches that the one who purified himself, remembered the Lord and prayed succeeded.
translations.Аль-Аляк означает «Сгусток крови». С это: Al-Alaq means "Blood Clot". The revelation of the Koran began with this Meccan sura: it commands to be read in the name of the Lord, reminds of the creation of man and the fact that man transgresses boundaries, imagining himself to be in need of nothing.
translations.Аль-Аср означает «Предвечернее время». К: Al-Asr means "Twilight Time". A short Meccan surah that a person is in loss, except for those who believe, do good and call for truth and patience.
translations.Аль-Баййина означает «Ясное знамение». С: Al-Bayyina means "The Clear Sign". The sura explains why the Prophet ﷺ was sent: so that a clear sign and truthful Scriptures would come to people. Its key verse reduces religion to its essence - to sincerely worship Allah, perform namaz and pay zakat. At the end there are two groups: the worst of creations and the best, for whom the Gardens of Eden are destined.
translations.Аль-Баляд означает «Город» — речь о Мекк: Al-Balyad means "The City" - talking about Mecca. The Sura says: man was created in hardship, but he is deceived by power and wealth, forgetting that Allah sees him and has endowed him with eyes, tongue and lips. The main thing in the sura is the “steep path”: freeing a slave, feeding an orphan or a poor man on a hungry day, and then being among the believers, who commanded each other patience and mercy.
translations.Аль-Бурудж означает «Созвездия» (небесны: Al-Buruj means "Constellations" (heavenly towers). The Meccan sura swears by the sky and the stars and talks about the “owners of the ditch” who burned believers for their faith, promising Gehenna to the tormentors, and gardens to the believers, and reminds that the Koran is kept in the Guardian Tablet.
translations.Аль-Гашия означает «Покрывающее» — одно: Al-Gashiya means "The Covering One" - one of the names of the Day of Resurrection. The Meccan sura depicts two outcomes: drooping, tormented faces in the blazing Fire and beatific faces in the sublime Garden, and then calls to look at the signs of creation.
translations.Аль-Инфитар означает «Раскалывание». Сур: Al-Infitar means "The Splitting". The sura describes the day when the sky will split, the stars will crumble, the seas will merge, and the graves will turn over - and the soul will know everything that it has done. Then follows a direct question to the person: what has deceived you regarding your Generous Lord? There are noble scribe angels above everyone, and on the Day of Retribution, power will belong only to Allah.
translations.Аль-Иншикак означает «Разверзание». Небо: Al-Inshiqaq means "The Opening". The sky will open, the earth will be stretched open and will vomit out everything that is inside - and both will submit to the Lord. The Sura reminds: a person goes to meet his Lord, and the book of affairs will be handed to him in his right hand or from behind his back. Oaths of the evening dawn, night and full moon lead to the main question: why don’t they believe?
translations.Аль-Кадр означает «Предопределение». Сур: Al-Qadr means "Predestination". The surah about the night of Predestination, on which the Koran was revealed: it is better than a thousand months and prosperous until the dawn.
translations.Аль-Кариа означает «Великое бедствие» (П: Al-Qaria means "The Great Calamity" (The Striking) - one of the names of the Day of Judgment. The Surah describes the shock of that Day and the weighing of deeds in the scales.
translations.Аль-Каусар означает «Изобилие» — это дар: Al-Kawthar means "Abundance" - it is a gift to the Prophet, peace be upon him. The shortest surah of the Koran: in gratitude it is ordered to pray for the sake of the Lord and make a sacrifice.
translations.Аль-Кафирун означает «Неверующие». Сура: Al-Kafirun means "The Disbelievers". The surah proclaims a clear distinction in worship and ends with the words: “To you is your religion, and to me is my religion.”
translations.Аль-Лейль означает «Ночь». Мекканская су: Al-Layl means "Night". The Meccan sura swears night and day and contrasts two paths: the generous, God-fearing person, for whom the path to the easiest is made easy, and the miser, who rejected the truth, for whom the path to the heaviest is made easier.
Al-Masad means "Palm Fibers". The sura says that the wealth and enmity of Abu Lahab, the Prophet’s worst enemy, did not save him from punishment.
translations.Аль-Маун означает «Мелочь» (посильная по: Al-Maun means “Trifle” (help within your power). The Sura condemns the one who considers retribution a lie, persecutes the orphan, is careless in prayer and refuses people even small help.
translations.Аль-Мульк означает «Власть». Начало суры: Al-Mulk means "Power". The beginning of the sura connects the power of Allah over all things with the purpose of life and death: a person is tested not by the quantity, but by the quality of his actions.
Al-Mutaffifin means "The Weighers". The surah begins with the menacing “Woe!” to those who demand full measure for themselves, but do not give it to others - deception in small things is called a direct road to denying the Day of Judgment. Further, the sura contrasts two books of deeds: Sijjin for sinners and Illiyun for the pious, and explains that the hearts of those who deny are covered with rust from their own deeds.
translations.Аль-Фаджр означает «Заря». Мекканская су: Al-Fajr means "Dawn". The Meccan sura swears by the dawn and nights, recalls the death of the Adites, Samudians and Pharaoh, condemns the love of wealth and neglect of the orphan, and ends with a joyful call to the peaceful soul to return to the Lord and enter Paradise.
translations.Аль-Фатиха означает «Открывающая». Сура: Al-Fatihah means "The Opener". The surah stands at the beginning of the Koran and is read in every rak'ah of prayer. In this lesson, you will first understand the meaning, then test yourself and pronounce the verse.
translations.Аль-Фатиха, потому что она основа молитв: Al-Fatihah because it is the basis of prayer
translations.Аль-Филь означает «Слон». Сура напоминае: Al-Fil means "The Elephant". The sura recalls how Allah protected the Kaaba and turned into nothing the plan of an army with a war elephant.
translations.Аль-Хумаза означает «Хулитель». Сура пор: Al-Humazah means "The Blasphemer". The Sura condemns the one who speaks evil of people, accumulates wealth and thinks that it will make him eternal, and warns of punishment by Fire.
translations.Ан-Наба означает «Весть». Мекканская сур: An-Naba means "The Message". The Meccan sura opens Juz Amma with the question: what are people arguing about? About the great news - the resurrection. The first half lists the signs of Allah in creation: earth-bed, mountains-pegs, sleep-rest, night-veil, seven strongholds, sun-lamp, rain and gardens - and leads to the Day of Discernment.
translations.Ан-Назиат означает «Исторгающие» — так н: An-Naziat means “The Extracters” - this is the name given to the angels who take away souls. The Meccan sura begins with five oaths, describes the horror of resurrection and cites the story of Musa and Pharaoh as an example: Pharaoh said “I am your most high Lord,” and Allah punished him in both worlds. This is a lesson for the God-fearing.
translations.Ан-Наср означает «Помощь». Сура возвещае: An-Nasr means "Help". The sura proclaims Allah's help and victory when people convert to Islam in crowds, and orders them to glorify the Lord and ask Him for forgiveness.
translations.Ат-Такасур означает «Страсть к приумноже: At-Takasur means "Passion for increase." The sura warns that the pursuit of wealth and superiority distracts a person until death, and then demand will follow.
translations.Ат-Таквир означает «Свёртывание». Первая: At-Takvir means "Collapse". The first half of the sura with twelve “whens” paints a picture of the end of the world: a collapsed sun, crumbling stars, shifted mountains, blazing seas - and a question to the girl killed alive, for what sin she was killed. The second half swears by the stars, night and dawn, defending the Prophet ﷺ: The Koran is the word of a noble messenger, not the speech of the devil.
translations.Ат-Тарик означает «Ночной путник» — ярко: At-Tariq means "Night Traveler" - a brightly shining star. The Meccan sura swears by the sky and the star, reminds that there is a guardian over every soul, points to the creation of man as an argument for the resurrection, and asserts that the Koran is a discriminating Word, not a joke.
translations.Ат-Тин означает «Смоковница». Сура клянё: At-Tin means "Fig Tree". The sura swears by the fig tree and the olive and reminds: man was created in the most beautiful form, and those who believed and did good will be saved.
translations.Ау зид алейхи ва раттилиль-Курана тартил: Au zid aleykhi va rattilil-Kurana tartilya
translations.Аш-Шамс означает «Солнце». Мекканская су: Ash-Shams means "Sun". The Meccan sura begins with a series of oaths by the sun, moon, day, night, sky, earth and soul, and ends with the fate of the Thamudians: the one who purified his soul succeeded, and the one who was mired in sin perished.
translations.Аш-Шарх означает «Раскрытие». Сура утеша: Ash-Sharkh means "Disclosure". The sura consoles the Prophet, peace be upon him: Allah opened his chest and lightened the burden, and promises that relief will certainly come with burden.

translations.Вторая половина суры Ан-Наба показывает: The second half of Surah An-Naba shows two roads of the Day of Discrimination: Gehenna as an ambush for those who transgress the border - and the success of the God-fearing with gardens, vineyards and full cups, where neither idle talk nor lies will be heard. The sura ends with a warning about imminent punishment and the words of the unbeliever: “It would be better for me to be dust!”
translations.Вторая половина суры зовёт человека посм: The second half of the sura calls a person to look at his own food: rain, broken earth, grains, grapes, olives, palm trees, gardens and pastures - all this is a gift from Allah. And then - a deafening voice, on the day of which a person will run away from his brother, mother, father, wife and children: each will have his own concern. Some faces will shine, others will be covered with dust.
translations.Вторая половина суры описывает награду б: The second half of the sura describes the reward of the pious: bliss, a bed, radiance on faces, a sealed drink with a seal of musk - “let those who compete for this sake compete.” And at the end of the sura it brings the picture back: in worldly life, sinners laughed at believers and winked at each other, but in the Hereafter everything will turn upside down.
translations.Вторая половина суры отвечает отрицающим: The second half of the sura answers those who deny resurrection: creating the sky, spreading the earth, bringing out water and pastures is more difficult than bringing a person back to life. Further, the sura divides people into two: the one who has transgressed the boundaries and loved the worldly will receive Hell, and the one who feared the Lord and kept the soul from passions will receive Paradise. Only Allah knows about the time of the Hour.

translations.Сукун (ـْ) означает, что у буквы нет сво: Sukun (ـْ) means that the letter does not have its own vowel: it closes the syllable. تَبْ reads "tab".
translations.Сукун показывает остановку голоса без до: Sukun shows stopping the voice without adding a vowel.
translations.Сукун появляется только из-за остановки: Sukun only appears due to stopping
translations.Сура Курайш напоминает племени курайшито: Surah Quraysh reminds the Quraish tribe of the mercy of Allah: safe trade trips, food and protection are a reason to sincerely worship the Lord of the Kaaba.
translations.Сура многократно возвращает слушателя к: The Surah repeatedly brings the listener back to responsibility before the Day of Discrimination. Ayahs 20-23 provide proof close to man: his creation and development occur according to an exact measure.
translations.Сура напоминает о происхождении человека: The Surah recalls the origin of man, his ability to hear and see, and the path shown to him. After instruction, a person shows gratitude or ingratitude.
translations.Сура начинается клятвой письменной трост: The Surah begins with an oath with a writing reed and what people write down, and then emphasizes the great character of the Prophet. The lesson combines knowledge, responsibility for speech and character.
translations.Сура открывается упоминанием Дня воскрес: The Surah opens with the mention of the Day of Resurrection and the soul that reproaches itself. Together, these images teach responsibility: future calculation is associated with an honest assessment of oneself now.
translations.Сура передаёт терпеливый призыв пророка: The Surah conveys the patient call of the Prophet Nuh to his people. He turned to them night and day and called to ask for forgiveness from the Lord.
translations.Сура призывает к искреннему покаянию и п: The Sura calls for sincere repentance and gives an example of the faith of Pharaoh's woman. Her environment did not determine her choice: she asked for closeness to Allah and salvation from injustice.
translations.Сура связывает ночное поклонение с подго: The Sura connects night worship with preparation for a weighty word. The Koran is ordered to be read measuredly, remembering the name of the Lord and turning to Him with all your heart.
translations.Сура учит красивому терпению и описывает: The Surah teaches beautiful patience and describes the stable qualities of believers. Among them is the recognition of a certain share of property for the one asking and the deprived.
translations.Сура учит смотреть на испытание без упро: The Surah teaches us to look at a test without simplification: difficulty occurs with the permission of Allah, faith guides the heart, and beloved gifts can become a test of priorities.

translations.ب и م образуются смыканием губ; و без ма: ب and م are formed by closing the lips; و without madda is pronounced by bringing the rounded lips together. For م the nasal component is also important.
translations.ت د ط имеют близкое место выхода у основ: ت د ط have a close exit point at the base of the upper incisors, but differ in quality. ط is pronounced firmly, ت - with an exhalation, د - loudly.
translations.ر соединяется с предыдущей буквой, но не: ر connects to the previous letter, but not to the next one.
translations.ز س ص сопровождаются направленной струей: ز س ص are accompanied by a directed stream of air and a whistling tone. ص is hard; س remains thin, ز is ringing.
translations.س — «с», ش — «ш». ص и ض — эмфатические (: س - “s”, ش - “w”. ص and ض - emphatic (hard) “s” and “d”, pronounced with tension of the tongue.
translations.ش — солнечная: ل не звучит, а ش удваивае: ش - solar: ل does not sound, but ش doubles
translations.ض выходит с боковой стороны языка у верх: ض comes out from the side of the tongue at the upper molars. ل forms closer to the anterior edge of the tongue and upper gums.
translations.ض и ل имеют полностью одинаковый махрадж: ض and ل have completely identical mahraj
translations.ض и ل используют бок языка, но разные ег: ض and ل use the side of the tongue, but different parts of it
translations.ط и ظ — эмфатические «т» и «з». ع — горт: ط and ظ - emphatic “t” and “z”. ع - guttural sound "ain", غ - burry "g", similar to the French "r".
ع and ح are formed in the middle part of the throat. ع cannot be replaced with a regular vowel, and ح requires a pure breath sound without the Russian “x”.
translations.غ губная, а خ носовая: غ is labial, and خ is nasal
translations.غ и خ выходят из верхней части горла, бл: غ and خ come from the top of the throat, closer to the mouth. The sounds are related in place, but غ is voiced, and خ is voiceless.
translations.ف образуется соприкосновением внутренней: ف is formed by the contact of the inner side of the lower lip with the edges of the upper incisors. Don't replace it with a harder bow sound.
translations.ف — «ф», ق — глубокий «къ» из глубины го: ف - “f”, ق - deep “k” from the depths of the throat, ك - regular “k”.
translations.ق глубже и тверже, ك ближе ко рту и тонь: ق is deeper and harder, ك is closer to the mouth and thinner
translations.ق образуется глубже задней частью языка: ق is formed deeper at the back of the tongue and is pronounced firmly. ك comes out a little closer to the mouth and remains thin.
translations.ق ط ب во всех положениях: ق ط ب in all positions

translations.ل, ن и ر формируются у передней части яз: ل, ن and ر form at the front of the tongue and upper gums, but not at the same point. ر requires a controlled touch without unnecessary repeated vibration.
translations.ه — лёгкий выдох «х». و и ي как согласны: ه - light exhalation “x”. و and ي as consonants give “v” and “y” (and as long vowels - “u” and “i”).
